extras: Works entirely offline and makes no network requests. The plugin is noted as being young.
intentEvidence: View and edit the metadata stored inside PNG files, right in Obsidian.
problem: Users need a way to inspect and modify the embedded metadata within PNG images directly within the Obsidian environment.
summary: PNG Metadata Editor allows users to view and edit metadata stored within PNG files, including dedicated support for SillyTavern character cards.
